title: thin ice
pitch: cozy ice fishing under the aurora. fight the fish, fill the bucket, and haul it to shore before the ice gives out.
controls: hold anywhere to drop the line, let go to stop. on a bite: hold to reel, let go when the fish runs. haul the bucket to shore before the ice breaks. space works too. h hauls, r reels in, l opens the fish log, m mutes.
how_to: hold to drop your line, let go to wait for a bite
hold to reel, let go when the fish runs
every fish loads the ice: haul to shore before it breaks
the bait shop sells longer line for the deeper layers
